spans.s: शब [śaba] व [v] रः [rḥ], (व) रः 1 A mountaineer, barbarian, savage; राजन् गुञ्जाफलानां स्रज
N. of a celebrated commentator and writer on Mīmāṁsā.

A female Kirāta who was an ardent devotee of Rāma. -Comp. -आलयः the abode of wild mountaineers or barbarians. -कन्दः a sweet potatato.-बलम् an army of mountaineers; वनमार्गेण दुर्गेण गच्छ- न्नधिकबलेन शबरबलेन रभसादभिहन्यमानः
शब [śaba] ब [b] ल [l], (ब) ल a. (शप्-अल, बश्च
Spotted, brindled, variegated; क्वचित् प्रभा चान्द्रमसी तमोभिश्छायाविलीनैः शबलीकृतेव
ला, ली A spotted or brindled cow.
The cow of plenty or Kāmadhenu q. v. -लम् Water.
शाब [śāba] व [v] र [r], (व) र a. (-री f.) [शब(व)र-अण्]

N. of a teacher and author of a well-known commentary (शाबरभाष्य) on the Mīmāṁsā-sūtras; see शबर.-री A low form of the Prākṛita dialect (spoken by mountaineers &c. -Comp. -भेदाख्यम् (also भेदाक्षम्) copper.
शबलिमन् [śabaliman], Variegated condition or appearance; शबलिमा बलिमानमुषो वपुः Śi.6.27.
Sound (the object of the sense of hearing and property of आकाश); अथात्मनः शब्दगुणं गुणज्ञः पदं विमानेन विगाहमानः
Sound, note (of birds; men &c.), noise in general; विश्वासोपगमादभिन्नगतयः शब्दं सहन्ते मृगाः Ś.1.14; स शब्दस्तुमुलो$भवत्
The sound of a musical instrument; वाद्यशब्दः
A word, sound, significant word (for def. &c. see Mbh. introduction); एकः शब्दः सम्यगधीतः सम्यक् प्रयुक्तः स्वर्गे लोके कामधुग्भवति; so शब्दार्थौ.
A declinable word, a noun, substantive.
A title, an epithet; यस्यार्थुक्तं गिरिराज- शब्दं कुर्वन्ति बालव्यजनैश्चमर्यः
The name, mere name as in शब्दपति q. v.
Verbal authority (regarded by the Naiyāyikas as a Pramāṇa.

A technical term. -Comp. -अक्षरम् the sacred syllable ओम् uttered aloud. -अतीत a. beyond the power or reach of words, indescribable. -अधिष्ठानम् the ear.-अध्याहारः supplying a word (to complete an ellipsis).-अनुकृतिः onomatopœia. -अनुरूप a. proportionate or corresponding to the sound; शब्दानुरूपेण पराक्रमेण भवि- तव्यम्
. -अनुशासनम् the science of words; i. e. grammar. -अर्थः the meaning of a word. (-र्थौ dual) a word and its meaning; अदोषौ शब्दार्थौ K.
; न त्वयं शब्दार्थः, व्यामोहादेषा प्रतीतिः ŚB. on

. -अलं- कारः a figure of speech depending for its charmingness on sound or words and disappearing as soon as the words which constitute the figure are replaced by others of the same meaning (opp. अर्थालंकार); e. g.; see K.
. -आख्येय a. to be communicated in words; शब्दाख्येयं यदपि किल ते यः सखीनां पुरस्तात्

. (-यम्) an oral or verbal communication. -आडम्बरः bombast, verbosity, high-sounding or grandiloquent words. -आदि a. beginning with शब्द (as the objects of sense); शब्दादीन् विषयान् भोक्तुं चरितुं दुश्चरं तपः
. -इन्द्रियम् the ear. -कारa. sounding, sonorous. -कोशः a lexicon, dictionary.-ग a.
uttering sounds. -गत a. inherent or residing in a word. -गतिः music, song.-गुण a. having sound for its quality; अथात्मनः शब्दगुणं गुणज्ञः
. -गोचरः the aim or object of speech.

the ear. -ग्रामः the range or reach of sound. -चातुर्यम् cleverness of style, eloquence. -चित्रम् one of the two subdivisions of the last (अवर or अधम) class of poetry (wherein the charm lies in the use of words which please the ear simply by their sound; see the example given under the word चित्र).-चोरः 'a word-thief', a plagiarist. -तन्मात्रम् the subtle element of sound. -नेतृ m. N. of Pāṇini. -पतिः a lord in name only, nominal lord; ननु शब्दपतिः क्षितरेहं त्वयि मे भावनिबन्धना रतिः
. -पातिन् a. hitting an invisible mark the sound of which is only heard, tracing a sound; शब्दपातिनमिषुं विससर्ज
. -प्रमाणम् verbal or oral evidence. -बोधः knowledge derived from verbal testimony. -ब्रह्मन् n.
the Vedas; शब्द- ब्रह्मणि निष्णातः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति Maitra.
spiritual knowledge consisting in words, knowledge of the Supreme Sprit or the Spirit itself; शब्दब्रह्मणस्तादृशं विवर्तमितिहासम्
a property of words called स्फोट q. v. -भाव्यत्वम् the state of becoming known through scriptural word only; कर्मणः शब्दभाव्य- त्वात्...
. (on which Śabara writes अथेह कर्मणः शब्दभाव्यत्वम् । नान्यतः शक्यमेतज्ज्ञातुं कस्यापूर्वस्य धर्मा इति ॥-भिद् f. perversion of words. -भेदिन् a. hitting a mark merely by its sound. (-m.)
a kind of arrow. -योनिः f. a root, radical word. -लक्षण a. what is determined by the sacred word; इह शब्दलक्षणे कर्मणि यथाशब्दार्थं प्रवृत्तिः ŚB. on
. -वारिधिः a vocabulary. -विद्या, -शास्त्रम् the science of words; i. e. grammar; अनन्तपारं किल शब्द- शास्त्रम्
; Śi.2.112;14.24. -विरोधः opposition of words (in a sentence). -विशेषः a variety of sound.-विशेषणम् (in gram.) an adjective, adjectival word.-वृत्तिः f.
the function of a word (in Rhet.).
the power of a word (to convey sense), indicative power (लक्षणा); अदृष्टार्थाच्छब्दवृत्तिर्लघीयसी ŚB. on
.-वेधिन् a. hitting an invisible mark the sound of which is only heard; see शब्दपातिन्; अभ्याससाध्यं निखिलं मत्वा संतमसे व्यधात् । इषुपातानभूद्येन शब्दवेधविशारदः ॥
a warrior who pierces his enemies by mere sounds;
an epithet of Arjuna. -वेध्य a. to be shot at without being seen; एवं मयाप्यविज्ञातं शब्दवेध्यमिदं फलम्
. -वैलक्ष्यण्यम् verbal difference. -शक्तिः f. the force or expressive power of a word; signification of a word; see शक्ति.

the correct use of words. -श्लेषः a play or pun upon words, a verbal equivoque; (it differs from अर्थश्लेष in-as-much as the pun dissappears as soon as the words which constitute it are replaced by others of the same signification, whereas in अर्थश्लेष the pun remains unchanged; शब्दपरि- वृत्तिसहत्मर्थश्लेषः.) -संग्रहः a vocabulary, lexicon. -संज्ञा (in gram.) a technical term;
. -साधन, -साहa. See शब्दवेधिन्; ततो$स्त्रं शब्दसाहं वै त्वरमाणो महारणे
. -सौष्ठवम् elegance of words, a graceful or elegant style. -सौकर्यम् ease of expression. -स्मृतिः f. philology.-हीनम् the use of a word in a form or meaning not sanctioned by standard authors.
शब्दन [śabdana], a. [शब्द् ल्यु-ल्युट् वा] Sounding, making a sound.
नम् Sounding, making a noise, uttering a sound.
To make a noise, sound; शब्दा- यन्ते मधुरमनिलैः कीचकाः पूर्यमाणाः
To cry, roar, scream, yell; शब्दायमानमव्यात्सीत् भयदं क्षणदाचरम्>
To call, call out to; एते हस्तिनापुरगामिन ऋषयः शब्दायन्ते Ś.4;
Sounded, made to give out a sound, played upon (as a musical intrument).
Taught, explained; ज्ञानेन वैयासकिशब्दितेन भेजे खगेन्द्रध्वजपादमूलम्
To speak, call out, call out to; विततमृदुकराग्रः शब्दयन्त्या वयोभिः परिपतति दिवो$ङ्के हेलया बालसूर्यः Śi.11.47.
To name, call; ब्रह्मेति परमात्मेति भगवानिति शब्द्यते
. -With अभि to name. प्र to explain. -सं to call out to.
Relating to or derived from a word.
Relating to or depending on sound (opp. आर्थ).

Nominal (as inflection). -ब्दः A philologist, grammarian. -ब्दी N. of Sarasvatī. -Comp. -बोधः perception or apprehension of the sense of words.-व्यञ्जना (in rhet.) insinuation founded on words (opp. to आर्थव्यञ्जना).
सबन्ध [sabandha], a. Secured by a pledge.
Of the same family. -न्धुः A relation, kinsman.
सबल [sabala], a. Accompanied by a force or army.
साबाध [sābādha], a. Disordered, deranged; प्रियायाः साबाधं तदपि कमनीयं वपुरिदम् Ś.3.9.
सबीजयोगः [sabījayōgḥ], A kind of yogic meditation or Samādhi. This is referred to as संप्रज्ञातसमाधिः in
; मैत्र्यादि- चित्तपरिकर्मविदो विधाय क्लेशप्रहाणमिह लब्धसबीजयोगाः Śi.4.55.
सब्रह्मचर्यम् [sabrahmacaryam], Fellow-studentship (being disciples of the same teacher).
A fellow-student, one going through the same studies and observing the same austerities; सब्रह्मचारिण्येकाहमतीते क्षपणं स्मृतम्
A fellowsufferer, sympathiser; दुःखसब्रह्मचारिणी तरलिका क्व गता K.; हे व्यसनसब्रह्मचारिन् यदि न गुह्यं ततः श्रोतुमिच्छामि
(Hence) An equal, of the same kind;
